reviews.heading: See why everyone's lighting up their balcony

items.name: Melissa G.
items.title: Kids on the sidewalk waving at Santa
items.text: We're on the 3rd floor and you can see it from the end of the street. First night up, a family stopped and the little ones waved at the Santa for five minutes. Worth every cent.

items.name: Mark D.
items.title: Condo friendly, no drilling
items.text: Our building bans anything screwed in. This is just zip ties on the railing and one plug. Fifteen minutes start to finish and it sits completely flat.

items.name: Carmen D.
items.title: A new design every night
items.text: The app has so many designs my kids fight over who picks tonight's. The penguins and the gingerbread man are the favorites. Brightness is adjustable too.

items.name: Linda M.
items.title: Easy even for me
items.text: I'm not a tech person. Plug in, open the app, tap a picture. The remote does the basics if you don't want the phone. My grandson was speechless.

items.name: Raj P.
items.title: Arrived well packed
items.text: Nice box, everything sorted inside: curtain, controller, remote, zip ties. Had it running the same evening.

items.name: Sarah K.
items.title: Our cat is obsessed
items.text: Honestly the cat watches it more than we do. It looks just as good from inside the apartment through the window.

items.name: Tom W.
items.title: Measure your railing first
items.text: Looks amazing. My balcony is wider than one curtain so I ended up getting the 2 pack and running them side by side. Plan for that if yours is long.

items.name: Priya N.
items.title: Bought one for my parents too
items.text: Sent one to my parents' apartment so we can both put up the same design on Christmas Eve. The 2-pack made it easy.

items.name: Lucas F.
items.title: Not just for Christmas
items.text: Ran a pumpkin design for Halloween and our team logo on game day. It stays on the railing all season and I just change the picture.

items.name: Grace M.
items.title: Best balcony on the block
items.text: Every other balcony has a sad string of lights. Ours has a Santa sleigh flying across. People literally take photos of it.

faq: It's a curtain of tiny smart LEDs that you zip-tie to the front of your balcony railing. Plug the controller in, open the app, and every LED works together like one big picture. Pick a design and it shows up on your balcony instantly.
Is it easy to set up?
Yes. Lay it along the top rail, fix it with the included zip ties, plug in the controller. Most people are done in about 15 minutes. No drilling, no tools, no electrician.
Over 10,000 in the app: Santa, reindeer, snowmen, trees, greetings, animations, plus Halloween, birthdays and more. You can also draw your own or type a message.
Can I control it from my phone?
Yes, with the free app over Bluetooth, or with the included remote. Change designs, brightness and speed, or set a timer so it switches on and off by itself.
Yes. It's made for balconies and handles rain, snow and cold. Keep the controller under cover or in a weatherproof outlet box.
Orders are packed within 1 to 2 business days and arrive in 6 to 10 business days with free, insured, tracked shipping. Every order has a 30-day money-back guarantee.
